did: The owner said a take kept playing after they left the page. Every screen already stopped playing and recording when it closed; what slipped through was leaving the app with back or Home, which hides the page without closing the screen. Now the phone's player stops a take when the page hides, a take being recorded ends and is kept, a take still loading stays quiet when you come back, and a lint rule keeps every recording playing through that one player. Nothing on the phone holds a socket open behind a screen: the only one is Game day's, and it closes when you leave.

calls.title: What leaving the app does to a take playing (C760)
options: Stop it as Stop does; nothing resumes on return
Pause it, and resume where it was on return
Leave it to each screen's own handling
calls.why: The owner asked that leaving stop it the same as pausing; a take's row has Play and Stop and no position, so a resume would be a new behaviour.
calls.undo: Drop the page watch in the kit's player and the take pattern, and give screens a resume instead.

left: Takes, Kept, Needs your attention and My data read a take's audio themselves, so one still loading when the app hides and returns can still start on return (#3283).
